verdict.reason: All five local AD dumps are multivariate. SMD is the only multi-entity sealed-test candidate, and even its frozen channel-18 proxy would attach machine-level labels (path C), which this book forbids presenting as independent univariate samples. MSL/SMAP/PSM/SWaT need a multivariate Consumer to interpret system-level labels. No candidate is AS_IS_UNIVARIATE. None clears FIXED_CHANNEL_PER_ENTITY without weak-label overclaim. Yahoo download is therefore not forced by emptiness; it remains a user choice if the exam must stay univariate without a new adapter.
